title: 14-BCV-002 - Tall wall generic engineered details
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Both 14-BCV-002 and 14-BCV-002R1 are explicitly marked [WITHDRAWN] in the catalogue.

facts.text: The catalogue lists an original 14-BCV-002 and revised 14-BCV-002R1, and marks both withdrawn.

The R1 document permits the referenced residential tall-wall guideline values to be used for maximum unsupported wall heights under Article 9.23.10.1; project-specific tall-wall details must appear on building-permit drawings, and work outside guideline criteria still needs site-specific engineering.

limitations: This is a provincial regulator-issued STANDATA/standing variance, not an individual application, applicant statement, project drawing, permit record or site-specific decision.
The records address the Alberta Building Code 2014 and, where noted, Alberta Fire Code 2014; do not treat them as proof of applicability under the Alberta 2023 code edition or current law.
Catalogue status is recorded as displayed on the retrieved official page. A missing [WITHDRAWN] label is not evidence of current validity; PDFs display an Archived watermark.
